study.question: After fixed action direction and common-mean removal, is actual historical click membership sufficient for the target-match action consumer at constant contrast magnitude, and does its utility depend on residual task routing?
study.hypothesis: Observation: r0051 click/shift AUCs are 0.6659594520820193/0.6636832723660762 for task routing and 0.6647595313081196/0.6619936316312717 for shared routing (gaps 0.0022761797159431 and 0.0027658996768479; difference of gaps -0.0004897199609048). Its adaptive symmetric-RMS radius still depends on learned observed action embeddings. Mechanism hypothesis: within-block target-match/click-membership association, represented by (g-p)u for fixed alternating unit axis u and history click fraction p, can support most of that placement contrast without adaptive amplitude. For block-centered coefficient c, sum c*(g-p)u equals sum c*g*u in exact arithmetic. No gain, parameter-free substitution alone, or single favorable run establishes a mechanism. Current incumbent g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached remains stronger (0.666753547526167).

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text arXiv:1706.06978v4 lines257-277 describes unnormalized target-aware local activation, and lines317-336 Dice scale dependence. Inherit these adapted components; replace only a stopped residual match-action magnitude with a constant binary-membership code. No DIN reproduction or novelty claim.

Pinned commit90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d forward lines113-159 pools history then mixes field and task tokens. Current study retains residual-bank readouts and adds no tokenizer or interaction blocks; this is benchmark-code inspection, not audited original-method equivalence.

Same pinned benchmark forward lines175-200 flattens event/context features and tokenizes them for shared interaction before task towers. This study does not flatten or learn a tokenizer; it isolates a consumer-specific fixed membership statistic. Original-method priority remains unverified.

inherited_components: Entire standalone r0051 Model, including framework embeddings, scorer/towers, summary coefficients and residual bank creation order.
All original history-mask and feedback restrictions, click-index lookup by label name and valid-rank block rotation.
Fixed alternating unit axis, common-mean removal, original synthetic occupied-group fallback and FP32 construction followed by inherited BF16 contractions.
Historical action means and paired radii are still computed and discarded in unit mode to minimize graph/cost differences; no efficiency claim.
All four adapted task losses and separate task heads, observed pool/ordinal paths, source gradient ownership and shared/task routing.

Trajectory review: total action erasure/context replacement at r0024 fell near0.641 versus0.66675 incumbent; value-only r0025 retained0.666244 while scorer-only r0025 fell to0.654174. Match-only summary branch r0027 was0.651463; restoring pools improved later branches. Stopped observed-vs-item-duplicate r0037 gave0.666169 vs0.663624. r0045 residual-click0.664247 versus residual-shift0.666017 reversed the mean placement direction. r0048 fixed-direction real0.665989 exceeded shift0.663776; opposite-radius real r0049 fell to0.664244; paired-RMS r0050 restored0.665893. r0051 removing common mean changed task real by+0.00006693 and task shifted by-0.00011395 versus r0050, not exact empirical invariance. These are lower-performing or diagnostic trajectories, not independent repeats or proof of a unique explanation; all exposed trial statuses succeeded and no runtime failure is currently reported.
study.proposed_difference: Add one architecture switch summary_radius_source in {adaptive,unit}, default unit in four submitted modules. After the inherited paired-RMS computation override radius32 with ones_like only in unit mode. At valid positions with both groups the stream becomes (g-p)u, with zero for empty/single-group histories; invalid slots retain their old values but are excluded from summaries. This removes direct learned action-vector content from residual match-action rows0/4 at fixed membership, without erasing historical feedback elsewhere. Compare the four new placement/routing cells against their exact existing r0051 adaptive counterparts. No new learned state, RNG, data, target action, loss, module, input width or capacity; no originality claim.
predictions: At a fixed input/parameter state, unit-mode valid synthetic actions are invariant to any finite perturbation of the action embedding vectors while membership/masks remain fixed; this claim is only for the helper and match-action rows0/4, not full-model predictions.

For both groups, the unit synthetic stream has zero count-weighted mean, occupied-group distance1 and energy N*p*(1-p). Real/shifted membership preserves global and per-block counts, hence per-history stream energy; summary energy need not match. Empty or single-group valid histories give zero.

Primary prospective contrasts: click AUC real-minus-shifted at unit radius is positive under both routings. Report signed magnitudes, absolute AUC/Logloss and retained fraction versus the adaptive gaps without an invented significance threshold.

A unit-placement gap with little adaptive-versus-unit loss would support restricted membership sufficiency; routing interaction is a separate signed difference of differences and may be null. No expectation of beating the incumbent is required.

Report all task metrics, auxiliary mean separately, history/behavior/frequency/missing-field slices with counts if supplied by host, measured parameter/cost/memory and inference latency/throughput. Preserve inferior auxiliary quality relative to DIN instead of selecting on task mean.
falsifiers: Any changed input visibility, original mask, host recipe, learned module/RNG construction, item/ordinal stream or current-label dependence invalidates the attribution contrast.

Adaptive bridge source must reduce exactly to the corresponding r0051 constructor/helper after deleting only switch plumbing and docstrings; host fixed-state parity and finite forward/backward remain required before strong attribution.

Loss or reversal of real-versus-shifted unit-radius gaps under both routings weakens sufficiency at this declared scale. Scale/optimization remains an alternative, requiring a discriminating follow-up rather than a universal refutation.
A placement advantage that fails paired-seed repetition or is driven by unsupported sparse slices is preliminary evidence only.

Any helper output change under finite action-vector perturbation in unit mode at fixed masks/membership, or change under invalid-item/action or target-action perturbation in valid model paths, requires correction before interpreting results.
alternative_explanations: Adaptive radius may be predictive, a learned time-varying scale, or merely improve optimization; a constant-unit loss does not separate these.
Unit radius1 may be mismatched to learned embedding amplitude; no training-distribution calibration is currently exposed and no data-derived scale is invented.
Routing changes effective function class despite equal allocated parameter count; all historical pools/masks retain feedback, so no conclusion about total historical-action necessity.

Autocast contraction rounding, Dice running statistics and dense AdamW scale sensitivity may produce trajectory differences; keep host BF16 fixed and request diagnostics through an authorized host interface only.
Many branches use the same seed and validation window; trajectories are mechanism contrasts, not independent repetitions, and adaptive reuse increases selection uncertainty.
The official_offline protocol may expose delayed actions that would be immature online; category/brand auxiliary labels are not advertisement-specific conversions.
